# Pinned TriAevum A32 frontend

These files are copied byte-for-byte from TriAevum commit
`a9b447709d4405848d75352354891059cebb9ff8`, the exact framework revision
recorded by the lost LEGO Chase recomp project.

Upstream: https://github.com/coccofresco/TriAevum

The A32 frontend depends on Capstone 5.0.7. Original upstream licenses and
attribution remain applicable. This directory is framework/support source only;
it does not contain Nintendo game data.
